lines: So long one thought would be various object imagining; who but thus not knowing of them thought does not arise.
l4.sanskrit_cite: tāvāneko vikalpaḥ syādvividhaṃ vastu kalpayan ye tvitthaṃ na vidusteṣāṃ vikalpo nopapadyate
